# `bitmap_count`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
bitmap_count(child)
```

Returns the number of set bits in the child bitmap.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT bitmap_count(X '1010');
```

Result:

```text
2
```

```sql
SELECT bitmap_count(X 'FFFF');
```

Result:

```text
16
```

```sql
SELECT bitmap_count(X '0');
```

Result:

```text
0
```
